comment: The order item status at which a customer's downloads become available.
modal: Determines when purchased downloads are released to the customer, based on the order item's status (such as Pending or Invoiced). Can be set per website.

comment: The default limit on how many times a downloadable link can be downloaded.
modal: The default maximum number of downloads allowed per link for new downloadable products. Individual products can override this. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether downloadable links can be shared rather than tied to the purchasing account.
modal: When **Yes**, download links are shareable and can be accessed without signing in to the purchasing account; when **No**, access is restricted to that account. Can be set per website.

comment: The default heading shown above a downloadable product's samples.
modal: The default title for the samples section on downloadable product pages. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The default heading shown above a downloadable product's links.
modal: The default title for the downloadable links section on product pages. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: Whether download links open in a new browser window.
modal: When **Yes**, downloadable links open in a new browser window or tab instead of the current one. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether downloads are delivered inline or as a file attachment.
modal: Sets the HTTP Content-Disposition for downloads, choosing whether files are served **inline** (shown in the browser) or as an **attachment** (prompting a save). Can differ per website or store view.
